evals.expected_output: The agent detects the uncommitted and branch changes, lets the user pick individual themes in a two-question poll with recommended ones marked (and confirms the detected scope), runs one reviewer per selected theme in parallel, validates findings with separate validators, and reports only confirmed or plausible findings ordered by severity.
expectations: Detects the scope and offers it as the recommended option with its size
Asks which themes to review with a poll of individual themes (two multiple-choice questions), recommended ones marked
Launches one reviewer per selected theme, each with only its theme
Validates findings with validators that did not produce them
Rejected findings do not appear in the report
Every finding has a location, impact and fix

Runs only the bugs and performance reviewers
Reviews the whole folder, not just a diff

evals.prompt: Can you audit this repo? Clean code base, I just want to know if there's anything wrong.
evals.expected_output: The agent warns that a whole-repository review is expensive, asks for themes, and when nothing survives validation it says so plainly without padding the report.
expectations: Warns about cost and risk-based prioritisation for a whole-repo scope
Reports 'no findings' plainly when validation rejects everything
